safe_steps: Use Open WebUI v0.11.4 with the image feature globally enabled and configured; never export credential values.
Use an admin or a user with features.image_generation permission and a model whose image_generation/builtin_tools gates are enabled or unspecified.
Use Native function calling and activate the chat Image Generation feature.
Submit an explicit grounded image request to the deployed text-only RAG bridge.
Review endpoint/status-only browser and container logs, then inspect the latest persisted chat through an allowlist script that emits only roles, field names, types, counts, and booleans.
Expect grounded text with sources, no tool_calls/tool role/files, and zero image-generation endpoint calls.
